title: AGO - Problem to ServiceNow (Connection) and PagerDuty
description: On Dynatrace Problem open, create ServiceNow Incident via Connection and PagerDuty in parallel, then comment cross-link. No SNOW password in script.

eventTrigger.filterQuery: event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM" AND event.status == "ACTIVE" AND (event.status_transition == "CREATED" OR event.status_transition == "UPDATED" OR event.status_transition == "REOPENED")

prepare-payload.name: prepare-payload
prepare-payload.description: Map Problem fields to SNOW/PD payload (app, P3/P4, L1-L3, runbook).

create-servicenow-incident.name: create-servicenow-incident
create-servicenow-incident.description: Create ServiceNow Incident via Connection (no password in file).

create-pagerduty-incident.name: create-pagerduty-incident
create-pagerduty-incident.description: Trigger PagerDuty Events API v2 (parallel with ServiceNow).

cross-link-snow-pd.name: cross-link-snow-pd
cross-link-snow-pd.description: Comment on ServiceNow INC with PagerDuty dedup_key (Connection).

input.comment: PagerDuty sync: dedup_key={{ result("create-pagerduty-incident").dedupKey }} | Dynatrace Problem={{ result("prepare-payload").problemUrl }} | Runbook={{ result("prepare-payload").runbookUrl }} | Problem ID={{ result("prepare-payload").problemId }}
